description: A cozy pixel-art office where every thread is a little worker: busy threads at their desks, planners at the whiteboard, threads that need you in the waiting room, idle ones chatting over coffee and having lunch together. Thirteen places to put it, each with its own floor plan, pets and hidden easter eggs (classic, neon streets, redwood camp, surf villa, New York penthouse, dusty annex, school, startup house, mountain cabin, villain's lair, spaceship, coffee shop, and a home office where every thread works from its own little home and they meet on video calls), a short tour the first time you open it, your real weather outside, your providers' usage, an office TV, office events, festivals through the year and chiptune-style sound.
